mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (user_id, category_id, title, content, like_count, view_count, created_at, updated_at, address) VALUES (#{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{likeCount}, #{viewCount}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{address})
INSERT INTO board_img (board_id, path, system_name, origin_name, main_whether) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{path}, #{systemName}, #{originName}, #{mainWhether})
mapper.select: SELECT b.board_id, user_id, category_id, delete_whether, title, content, like_count, view_count, created_at, updated_at, address, board_img_id, path, system_name, origin_name, main_whether FROM board b JOIN board_img bi ON b.board_id = bi.board_id WHERE b.delete_whether LIKE 'N' AND bi.main_whether LIKE 'M'
SELECT board_id, user_id, category_id, title, content, like_count, view_count, created_at, updated_at, address FROM board WHERE board_id = #{boardId} AND delete_whether LIKE 'N'
